headline: Continued $62,000 Tolman High School support contract and 2026-2027 virtual instruction day plan; approved in-school Taekwondo program.
summary: Members heard reports on new high school construction, drainage plans, and the Building Futures apprenticeship program. Superintendent Buck presented 2026 RICAS results, which showed lower proficiency in English and math than in 2025. Members approved a Taekwondo program and continued the virtual instruction day plan and a Tolman High School contract.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 29, 2026 meeting, 5 yes and 1 abstention.
Approved the Taekwondo MOA for a 4-week program in schools, unanimously.
Continued the 2026-2027 Virtual Instruction Day plan so special education packets can be provided to students.
Continued the Tolman Mass Insight contract, not to exceed $62,000, to allow conversations between school leadership and educators.
Passed executive session item A1, a discussion of a District employee's job performance, at legal counsel's request.
Approved sealing the executive session minutes, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to approve: Kimberly Grant Second: James Chellel Yea: Matthew Wildenhain, James Chellel, Angeliz Rosa, Kimberly Grant, and Joanne Bonollo Abstain: Juan Pablo Barrera Motion carries.
Motion to approve: Juan Pablo Barrera Second: Angeliz Rosa ... Yea: all Motion carries unanimously.
This item was continued with committee members requesting that packets for special ed students be provided to the students.
Chair Joanne Bonollo requested that this item be continued to allow for conversations to be had between school leadership and educators.
At the request of legal counsel, item A1 was passed.
1. Motion to seal Executive Session minutes: Matthew Wildenhain Second: Kimberly Grant Yea: All Motion carries unanimously.
